comment: AI-generated review; verified tests, required checks, and human approval remain merge gates.
instructions: Review for exploitable security, authorization, paid-provider abuse, secret exposure, input bounds, concurrency, supply-chain integrity, and production-readiness defects. Require file and line evidence. Avoid style-only comments.

rules.rule: EVIDENCE: report only actionable defects with file:line evidence, a concrete failure mode, and concise remediation.
PAID PROVIDERS: every route capable of consuming provider credits must authenticate server-side, fail closed on missing configuration, bound requests and outputs, and enforce durable abuse controls.
SECRETS: flag hardcoded credentials, environment files in deployment inputs, secrets exposed to clients or logs, and placeholder values that could be mistaken for production credentials.
INPUT: validate and bound untrusted input at the boundary, including body size, arrays, strings, provider selections, URLs, redirects, and response retention.
FAIL-CLOSED: authentication, authorization, deployment gates, and provider selection must deny when configuration is absent, ambiguous, or invalid.
CONCURRENCY: flag serverless in-memory security state, read-then-write races, duplicate expensive work, and missing idempotency on retryable operations.
SUPPLY CHAIN: require lockfile installs, immutable workflow dependencies, vulnerability gates, and exact deploy provenance.
TESTS: security behavior changes require executable regressions that exercise the actual failure boundary and can fail for the reported defect.
